_about: Automation lanes for the Cubase harness, read by make_cubase_harness.py. lanes: { "<JUCE parameter ID>": [[bar, value], [bar, tick, value], ...] }, values 0..1, 480 ticks per quarter; a step is two points one tick apart. Example: "gain": [[1, 0.5], [5, 1.0], [9, 0, 1.0], [9, 1, 0.2]]. The template's example plugin has no parameters, so it has no lanes.
